scripts.start:storefront: sh -c 'if [ ! -f apps/storefront/.next/BUILD_ID ]; then echo "[ROSTA] storefront production build missing; rebuilding at runtime"; npm run build:storefront; fi; exec npm --prefix apps/storefront run start'
scripts.start:admin: sh -c 'if [ ! -f apps/admin/.next/BUILD_ID ]; then echo "[ROSTA] admin production build missing; rebuilding at runtime"; npm run build:admin; fi; exec npm --prefix apps/admin run start'
scripts.typecheck:commerce: npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck:commerce-core
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:commerce && npm run typecheck:admin-app && npm run typecheck:storefront
scripts.build:all: npm run build:storefront && npm run build:admin
